title: Euclidean Clustering with Union-Find
hints: Union-find: `parent[i] = i`, `find` with path compression (`parent[x] = find(parent[x])`), `unite` by rank or size. `unite` returns false if already in the same set.
Neighbours without O(N²): hash every point into a voxel of side r (key = floor(p / r)). Two points within r are always in the same or an adjacent voxel, so check the 27 cells.
Only compare each pair once (e.g. j > i) and use `squaredNorm() <= r*r`.
Final labelling: walk i = 0..N-1, map each root to the next id the first time you see it, skipping roots whose set size is outside [min_size, max_size] (label -1).
